entities.name: 王家纸马铺's tall signboard
entities.what: The tall vertical signboard of 王家纸马铺 (the Wang family's paper-offerings shop), standing on its own at the south edge of the far street in front of the shop's south-west corner: a narrow board with dark side edges and a small cap on top, set in a low foot frame with two splayed feet. Written in one column down the board, about four or five characters, too small to resolve on this scan: □□□□(□).
entities.src: 名画记: 王家纸马铺 (pin 13)
entities.note: Strokes: board edges u 26880-26886 (west) and 26900-26905 (east) from v 80 to v 197, cap v 78-85; marks of characters in groups at v 97-111, 117-132, 140-153, 158-170 and 172-180 (four or five characters; none legible at the scan's resolution, so every character is □). Scholarship names the shop 王家纸马铺 and the board is commonly read 王家紙馬, but these strokes cannot confirm it: a builder who writes it should say it comes from the scholarship. Foot frame v 183-222 with the cross bar at v 215-225. A dark slanted bar above the cap, (26873, 47) to (26910, 63), is the shop's eave strut or a hook on the sign: unclear. Board about 25 px wide and 117 px tall, total height about 142 px at foot v 220 (SCALE CUE: the street's standing figures are 53-54 px at v 131-152). The restyle draws it as a black pole with a lamp and no writing. The brief's hint u 26850-26880 is about 30 px west of the strokes. Crops: scratchpad S2_t8/e_sign.jpg, e_sign_chars.jpg, e_sign_foot.jpg, top_26750.jpg, inspect_26930_150.jpg.
